title: Lightkeeper
tagline: Thirty-two lit worlds, one ship, and a swarm that will not wait.
teaser: Keep the lights of thirty-two worlds burning while self-replicating mining drones spread through the Reach. Answer calls before their deadlines, fight with beams and flares, and climb six ranks by the 1976 promotion rule. Every gleaner you stop makes the clock last longer.

manPage.synopsis: lightkeeper — answer the calls, stop the swarm, keep the lights on.
manPage.description: A reborn trek, Eric Allman’s 1976 space game from BSD Unix, with the systems its source hid: a reserve clock shared by the swarm, worlds that call for help and fall into forges, a six-rank career with the original’s promotion rule, and tournament codes that give everyone the same galaxy.

howToPlay: Click a zone on the chart to jump there; click a cell to move inside a zone.
Lower the shield and fire the beams, or aim a flare; gleaners answer every order.
Answer worlds’ calls before their deadlines, and moor at harbours to refill.
